added.summary: A cooked vector's strokes take stroke-dashoffset (it was refused), and its stroke outlines are kurbo's stroke expansion: offset curves, joins and caps as SVG draws them.
An icon's path data takes arcs (A and a), which were refused; every icon path is read by the same SVG path parser as documents and vectors.

fixed.summary: SVG path data, arcs, flattening, dashes and cubic-to-quadratic conversion are kurbo's in documents' inline <svg>, clip-path: path(), -og-text-path, cooked vectors and icons, one path model instead of three hand-written parsers. A dash list's dash that runs across a closed shape's start is one dash, not two cut at the seam; a gradient in objectBoundingBox units spans the shape's curves, not their control points; and path data errors name what is wrong in one wording everywhere. A zero-length dash due exactly at an open path's end draws no dot.
